messages:
incident-bot: ALERT fired -> PagerDuty: NODE_CRITICAL: gpu-node-42 in us-west-2 (rack-7). reason=kernel_panic, last_seen=kernel oops at 0xffff0000. autodrain=false. page_id=PD123456
pagerduty: Triggered incident PD123456. auto-escalation in 2m if no ack. Priority: P1. Affected tenants: 2 active Dedicated jobs, 14 hosted in-flight requests.
alice_oncall: Acked PD123456. I'm pulling serial console now.
bob_infra: thx. i'm checking nvme SMART and recent driver rollouts for that rack.
carol_sre: Any customer-facing impact? dave_support can you confirm alerts?
dave_support: Seeing 502 spikes in ap-east for a tiny subset of requests routed to that rack — ~0.8% error increase. I opened a quick ticket but not yet pageable.
alice_oncall: Serial console attached: shows repeated stack traces, kernel panic: "GPU watchdog timeout" followed by kernel oops. trying a remote soft-reboot (ipmi)
incident-bot: Action queued: ipmi powercycle requested by alice_oncall. ETA ~45s.
bob_infra: If it comes back we should cordon the node and drain pods, reimage if nvme errors persist. Also capture dmesg: <last 200 lines>
alice_oncall: ipmi powercycle completed, node responding to ping, kubelet NotReady. pulling kubelet logs: "failed to start Kubelet: node has no device plugin" then crashloop.
carol_sre: hmm crashlooping kubelet likely from corrupted NVIDIA driver or kernel module mismatch. Any recent kernel-rt upgrades on that host?
bob_infra: Not on that host, but there was a staged driver rollout yesterday in rack-6/7 (canary). I'm grabbing the package list.
dave_support: Two customers reported slowed batch jobs; one opened a support chat but not escalated. I'm posting a short status note.
alice_oncall: I'm cordoning gpu-node-42 to stop new pods: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-42` -> marked unschedulable. Starting drain with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
incident-bot: Drain initiated for gpu-node-42 by alice_oncall. Pods being evicted: 7 (4 Dedicated, 3 Hosted).
bob_infra: While evicting, I'm creating a snapshot of /var/log for forensic. Also running `smartctl -a /dev/nvme0` now.
carol_sre: Recommend failover routing for the 2 Dedicated jobs to their reserved capacity; does routing policy allow immediate failover?
alice_oncall: Yes, routing policy will pick dedicated-fallback pool after node drain. I've patched canary policy to prefer dedicated-alt for those jobs.
dave_support: Notifying affected customers: "We're investigating degraded performance in US-WEST. Engineers have isolated one GPU host and are mitigating. Will update in 15m"
bob_infra: smartctl shows no reallocated sectors but a couple of I/O errors in the last hour: 5 err_cnt. Possible transient NVMe hiccup. Also kernel messages show `nvidia: GPU reset failed` multiple times.
alice_oncall: kubelet still crashlooping with stack trace referencing `nvidia_uvm` module. Trying to unload module: `modprobe -r nvidia_uvm` -> fails because module in use.
carol_sre: If module unload fails, we should RMA the card and reimage host. But first, prioritize customer impact: have Dedicated tasks fully rehomed?
alice_oncall: Rehoming to dedicated-alt done for both Dedicated jobs. Hosted requests are being retried by routing layer; error rate trending down from 0.8% -> 0.2%.
dave_support: Customers acknowledged the message and one thanked for quick switch.
bob_infra: Given `GPU reset failed` + kernel panic + nvme io errs, I'm leaning hardware failure. I'll request a hot-swap and ask colo to reseat GPU 2 on rack-7.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: escalation sent to infra@redwood for device replacement.
carol_sre: Plan: 1) keep node cordoned and drained; 2) reimage from golden after hardware swap; 3) run postmortem kernel oops reproduction test in CI canary; 4) reopen if we see recurrence in rack-7. Assigning to bob_infra for RMA and alice_oncall for immediate mitigation follow-ups.
alice_oncall: Acknowledged. I'll leave node cordoned and keep watch on drift. Setting a 1h follow-up check.
bob_infra: Colo confirmed they'll reseat GPU within 30m. I've queued an RMA if reseat fails.
dave_support: Updating status page: "Mitigation in progress — traffic rerouted; some background jobs delayed. Next update in 30m."
incident-bot: Incident PD123456 annotated: impact=partial (some hosted retries), action=cordon+drain+failover, owner=alice_oncall, infra=bob_infra.
carol_sre: After immediate mitigation, please collect: kernel oops, `nvidia-smi -q` output (if available), dmesg, nvme logs, and the node metadata (ami/kernel version, driver package). We'll attach to postmortem.
alice_oncall: Copy. I'll stash logs to /tmp/forensics/gpu-node-42/ and share link.
bob_infra: Reseat attempt 1 failed to clear errors, RMA ticket opened (RMA-8742). Colo scheduled swap for next maintenance window + expedited RMA for 2hr SLA.
dave_support: Customer-facing note updated: expedited hardware replacement in progress; impacted customers have been offered credits if SLA breached.
alice_oncall: Last check: error rate steady at ~0.1%. I'll close the on-call loop for now but keep the incident open for hardware completion.
carol_sre: Good. We'll run regression tests once host is back. I'll create the postmortem skeleton and assign owners.
incident-bot: PD123456 status -> acknowledged -> monitoring for recurrence. Thread closed for live mitigation; will reopen on RMA completion or recurrence.
